remarks: Rare opportunity to own at Chatham Walk. The perfect location for walking to the Train, in town Shopping, the Library and Grocery Stores. This Townhouse offers you 1,524 sq.ft of living space with an additional 756 sq.ft in the finished basement. The spacious living/dining room open floor plan offers a comfortable living entertaining space. From the dining room walk onto the deck overlooking a private grassy area. The kitchen off of the dining room has granite counters, Fisher & Paykel refrigerator and a Miele dishwasher.  The primary bedroom upstairs has an en suite marble bathroom walk in shower. Very spacious his and her closets. Two other bedrooms offer spacious closets as well. A full bathroom in the hallway upstairs is for the other two bedrooms and a half bath for company on the main level. All bathrooms are renovated . The lower level offers lovely living space with a custom wine room. A separate laundry room is in the lower level with cabinets for storage. Many improvements have been made. New storm doors, all hardwood floors refinished, new HVAC system, new hot water heater, new panel for 200 amp service, wiring for tv in the finished lower level, new attic stairs, new fan in the en suite bathroom. Move in to enjoy the holiday season .
